skills.name: Sprout
skills.description: Floryn casts a blob of energy ahead that explodes upon hitting an enemy, dealing 175<font color='#27C0C7'>( +90% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font> to nearby enemies and stunning them for 0.7s (and revealing their positions briefly).
skills.tips: Floryn's primary healing skill. It restores HP for multiple targets.

skills.name: Sow
skills.description: Floryn tosses an Energy Seed at the target enemy, dealing 180<font color='#27C0C7'>( +100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#3B69FF'>(Magic Damage)</font>. Healing Fruits will then spawn and bounce to nearby allied heroes, restoring their <font color='#47BE34'>(HP)</font> by 175<font color='#27C0C7'>( +90% Total Magic Power)</font>.
skills.tips: Floryn's primary damage and control skill. Use it to poke and control enemies.

skills.name: Bloom
skills.description: Floryn resonates with Dew's power, restoring 250<font color='#27C0C7'>( +100% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color='#47BE34'>(HP)</font> to all allied heroes 2 times no matter where they are on the battlefield. This effect also removes any Healing Reduction or Shield Reduction effects on allied heroes, and makes them immune to those effects for 2s.
skills.tips: Use this skill to heal all your allies without distance limitation and turn the tide!

skills.name: Dew
skills.description:
Dew's <font color='#404495'>(Lantern)</font> will permanently increase Floryn's attributes by a small amount.
After leaving combat for 5s, Floryn can share the <font color='#404495'>(Flower of Hope)</font> with an allied hero (30s cooldown), which will grant them a 150<font color='#27C0C7'>( +80% Total Magic Power)</font> shield each time they are healed by Floryn.
Floryn will never sell the <font color='#404495'>(Lantern)</font>.
skills.tips: Try to hit enemies with Floryn's skills to stack up her Passive to maximize the power of Lantern.

items.name: Lantern of Hope
items.des: Unique Passive - Lantern of Hope: The equipment's attributes scale with hero level.

items.name: Necklace of Durance
items.des: Unique Passive - Gift: Regenerates 20% Max HP and Mana over 2s after leveling up.

items.name: Fleeting Time
items.des: Unique Passive - Timestream: Hero kills or assists reduce the Ultimate's current cooldown by 30%.

items.name: Oracle
items.des: Unique Passive - Bless: Received Shield and HP Regen effects are increased by 30%.

items.name: Immortality
items.des: Unique Passive - Immortal: Revives 2.5s after death, gaining 16% Max HP and a 220-1200 shield (scales with level) that lasts 3s (210s cooldown).

builds.tips: For equipment, we recommend this build to ensure Floryn's healing ability and durability.
